cues.text: Someone posts a call. Someone argues back. But testing that idea means a wallet, a deposit, and real risk.
Strike Agent changes that. Test the idea right where it happens: on X.
Mention Strike Agent with a market, a virtual margin, and leverage. Paper long Bitcoin, a hundred dollars, two-x.
This is a real receipt from our first live test. Paper position one. Long Bitcoin. A hundred dollars of margin at two-x, entered at the live Strike mark price. And no real order.
In that test, our server received the mention six and a half seconds after it was posted, and opened the position thirty nine milliseconds later.
Every X account gets its own ten thousand dollar virtual account. Go long or short on Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana or Cardano, at up to five-x.
Check your portfolio, pull a fresh price, close a position, and review your history and stats, all with simple commands.
Commands are strict and exact, so a reply only does what you typed. And only you can close your own positions.
Under the hood, X sends a signed webhook. We verify it, drop duplicates, and queue it safely.
Then we read a fresh Strike mark, apply simulated fees and slippage, update your paper ledger, and reply in the thread.
Stale prices are rejected, and a duplicate delivery never creates a duplicate trade.
And when you're ready for the real thing, every receipt links straight to Strike's own trading app. You decide, and you trade there.
Strike Agent. Practice on X. Trade on Strike.
